NOTICE
To use this script, you will need to enter an API token.
This token is used for API authentication purposes and WILL NOT be saved or sent ANYWHERE. This GUI is open-source and can be viewed.

Why do I need to enter an API Token?
An API Token is required to use the Spotify Web API.

Spotify Player only uses this API to do the following:
- Get the song that is currently playing
- Get album covers and artist avatars (to view in the UI)
- Control playback (such as skipping songs or pausing/resuming playback)

-------------------------------

in-game spotify player with media controls and more

- basic media controls (shuffle, previous song, play/pause, next song, repeat, seek)
- view the current song name, song cover, artist name(s), and artist avatar (hold down on images to enlarge)
- mini player (click spotify logo)

click on the key icon in the top right to get started

    for i, box in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do

                if box ~= game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character then

                    esp.Adornee = box
                    esp.ZIndex = 0
                    esp.Size = Vector3.new(5, 6, 2)

                    esp.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(0,255,0) --Color change
                    esp.AlwaysOnTop = true
                    esp.Name = "EspBox"
                end
            end
        end
    end
end
